description:
Crypto ETF net flows -- institutional inflows and outflows for spot BTC and ETH ETFs. Persistent net inflows are a bullish tape signal; heavy outflows bearish. Use it when the user asks about ETF flows, institutional demand or spot ETF activity.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_etf_flows
